slug: 2025-10-13 Somalia moves to finalize Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 with ITU support

facts.fact: The article says the 2025-2030 strategy builds on the National ICT Policy and Strategy 2019-2024 (per the corroboration paragraph, We Are Tech Africa, 16 October 2025); dated by the article's publication, 2025-10-13.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Technology, with ITU
